tools.name: search-documentation
tools.description: Search the available documentation for pages related to a user's query and return a list of related content matching the search criteria.

external_ids.title: External Ids
external_ids.description: Exact external ids to return (repeat the key). At most 100.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes (repeat the key). Matches the record's own currency, not the entity's functional currency.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Source platforms the records were ingested from (e.g. `stripe`, `ramp`). Customer-inserted records carry the platform they declared, or `api`.

platform_object_ids.title: Platform Object Ids
platform_object_ids.description: The source platform's own ids for the records (e.g. a Stripe `in_…` id).

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

date_from.title: Date From
date_from.description: Inclusive lower bound on the record's `date`.

date_to.title: Date To
date_to.description: Inclusive upper bound on the record's `date`.

amount_min.title: Amount Min
amount_min.description: Inclusive lower bound: decimal string, in the record's own currency, compared against `amount`. Requires exactly one value in `currencies`.

amount_max.title: Amount Max
amount_max.description: Inclusive upper bound: decimal string, in the record's own currency, compared against `amount`. Requires exactly one value in `currencies`.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Field to sort by. Amount sorts use each record's value in the entity's functional currency, so records in different currencies can look out of order; filter by one currency for a strict amount order.

expand.title: Expand
expand.description: Linked records to include under `expanded` (repeat the key).

__schema9.description: Include records act has since deleted. They carry `customFields.t0_deleted_at`. Default false: deleted records are omitted.

__schema12.description: Maximum records per page (1-200). A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is still set; iterate until it is null.

__schema13.description: Also return `total`, the number of matching records before the deleted overlay.

expand.title: Expand
expand.description: Linked records to include under `expanded` (repeat the key).

__schema2.description: Return the record even if act has deleted it; it then carries `customFields.t0_deleted_at`.

amount_max.description: Inclusive upper bound: decimal string, in the record's own currency, compared against `total`. Requires exactly one value in `currencies`.

status.title: Status
status.description: Record statuses to include (repeat the key).

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Field to sort by. Amount sorts use each record's value in the entity's functional currency, so records in different currencies can look out of order; filter by one currency for a strict amount order.

expand.title: Expand
expand.description: Linked records to include under `expanded` (repeat the key).

__schema9.description: Include records act has since deleted. They carry `customFields.t0_deleted_at`. Default false: deleted records are omitted.

__schema12.description: Maximum records per page (1-200). A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is still set; iterate until it is null.

__schema13.description: Also return `total`, the number of matching records before the deleted overlay.

expand.title: Expand
expand.description: Linked records to include under `expanded` (repeat the key).

__schema2.description: Return the record even if act has deleted it; it then carries `customFields.t0_deleted_at`.

external_ids.title: External Ids
external_ids.description: Exact external ids to return (repeat the key). At most 100.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes (repeat the key). Matches the record's own currency, not the entity's functional currency.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Source platforms the records were ingested from (e.g. `stripe`, `ramp`). Customer-inserted records carry the platform they declared, or `api`.

platform_object_ids.title: Platform Object Ids
platform_object_ids.description: The source platform's own ids for the records (e.g. a Stripe `in_…` id).

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

date_from.title: Date From
date_from.description: Inclusive lower bound on the record's `date`.

date_to.title: Date To
date_to.description: Inclusive upper bound on the record's `date`.
